description:
Tails and ships log files

Filebeat is an open source file harvester, mostly used to fetch logs files and feed them into logstash. Together with the libbeat lumberjack output is a replacement for logstash-forwarder.
Features and enhancements
Filebeat
- Update github.com/apache/thrift to v0.24.0. #52330
Fixes
All
- Add support for index in inputs for Beat receivers. #52662
Filebeat
- Add User-Agent to httpjson pagination requests. #52484
Metricbeat
- Recreate Kubernetes metadata watchers after their final metricset owner stops. #52028 #51833
